source.note: Clean isolated integration worktree; all tracked input bytes remained unchanged through tests and current-artifact export. Later summary/documentation publication does not change measured Rust source.

scope: All existing workspace Rust tests and current workspace executable artifacts, default features

report_selection.method: Complete current Cargo compiler-artifact executable set from cargo test --workspace --locked --no-run --message-format=json under cargo llvm-cov show-env instrumentation; LLVM export/show retains tool-default filename exclusions

exclusions: Historical shared-target executables not in the complete current Cargo artifact set
notes: Raw profiles were cleared before this independent measurement; compiled artifacts and prior reports were preserved.

The default shared-target report mixed stale main/worktree binaries and was not used for the published totals. Exact current-artifact selection corrected this; all current workspace members/targets and executed test binaries were retained. See issue #251.
Out-of-process shared-browser, privacy, cleanup and duplex journeys passed separately and are not included in these Rust percentages.
Coverage measures execution, not correctness. No paid-provider, native macOS/Windows or production TLS deployment certification is implied.

Every reported source file belongs to the measured worktree; workspace entrypoint mtimes were refreshed before measurement to avoid stale cross-worktree Cargo artifacts, without changing contents or deleting compiled caches.

Compared with prior record: lines -0.2540 percentage points, functions -0.3419 percentage points, regions -0.3528 percentage points. Earlier shared-target reporting may use different artifact provenance; the complete current artifact set is retained here.
